description: A form in the agent's reply using every input: values the user entered (openui.input), a failed email check after pressing Deploy, a link button.

events.text:
```openui
$env = "staging"
root = Form("deploy", [service, email, env, notes, when, canary, notify, agree], Buttons([deploy, docs]))
service = FormControl("Service", Select("service", [Option("api", "API"), Option("web", "Web app"), Option("worker", "Worker")], "Pick a service", { required: true }))
email = FormControl("Notify email", Input("email", "you@company.com", "email", { required: true, email: true }), "We send the report here")
env = FormControl("Environment", RadioGroup("env", [Option("staging", "Staging"), Option("prod", "Production")], null, $env))
notes = FormControl("Notes", TextArea("notes", "Anything the reviewers should know"))
when = FormControl("Date", DatePicker("when"))
canary = FormControl("Canary traffic", Slider("canary", 0, 50, 5))
notify = Switch("notify", "Post to #deploys")
agree = CheckBox("agree", "I checked the migration", { required: true })
deploy = Button("Deploy", @ToAssistant("Deploy with these settings"), "primary")
docs = Button("Runbook", @OpenUrl("https://example.com/runbook"))
```
